description:
Buy NO shares in a Stacks Market prediction market.

Uses the buy-no-auto function with slippage protection via a max-cost cap.
The transaction will fail if the cost exceeds max_cost_ustx.

Requires an unlocked wallet. Only available on mainnet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

max_cost_ustx.description: Maximum cost in micro-STX you are willing to pay (slippage protection)

shares.description: Number of NO shares to buy (integer, smallest unit)

target_cap_ustx.description: Target liquidity cap in micro-STX (use current market cap from stacks_market_get)

name: stacks_market_buy_no
